title: mariosousa heterophylla
intro: Mariosousa heterophylla, commonly known as the Guanacaste tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is native to Central and South America and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The Guanacaste tree is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Mariosousa heterophylla include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
